answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a physical microfluidic challenge-response, where a piezo-electric micro-valve modulates electro-osmotic flow through a trellis of microchannels to generate a unique crystal timing signature. Validators then thread this hydrodynamic fingerprint into the agent's credential chain, so a single physical device cannot cheaply spawn many. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
